panels.description: Alex and Ada pass the faded LAST CHANCE sign in a crowded Keel lane. Keep the sign prominent and leave upper space.
Alex turns Adrian's worn casino chip between his fingers; the looping equation is visible but not magical. Leave upper space for Ada's line.
Alex stops beneath the casino sign, shoulders tight. Ada faces him with practical directness; leave upper third clear.
Alex closes his hand around the chip, knuckles whitening. Keep the faded sign blurred behind him and leave upper space.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Same hands built pumps and lost rent.
